_about: English, the game's words by key. To translate: copy this file to lang/<code>.json (fr, ja, ...), translate the values, keep the keys and the {blanks}. A list is a pool of lines, one picked at random.
levelup.title: LEVEL UP!
raid.warning: A horde is coming out of the mist from the {side}! ({count})
raid.dawn: At dawn the horde fell back into the mist
bark.cold: We need a fire in the house.
bark.chilly: So cold... I wish I had a scarf.
This wind cuts right through me.
bark.chilly.scarf: Still cold, even with the scarf.
Brr. Good thing I've a scarf.
miko.starving: So hungry... I can barely walk.
talk.hello.cold: It's bitter out, {miko}. I can hardly hold my tools.
Brr. Is it this cold every winter?
My fingers stopped working an hour ago.
talk.hello.tired: *yawn* I could sleep for a week.
talk.hello.homeless: I've been sleeping by the fire...
I wish I had a bed of my own.
talk.reply.gift.none: That's sweet of you, but your bag's empty.
talk.reply.norumor: It's been quiet. Nothing worth telling.
Not a thing. I'll tell you if I do.
talk.need.bed: A bed of my own, in a house.
Somewhere to sleep that isn't the ground.
talk.need.food: Food in storage. We're running out.
Something to eat, for all of us.
talk.need.scarf: A scarf. This cold gets into my bones.
Something warm round my neck: a scarf would do.
talk.need.tools: Tools! I can't work with my bare hands.
New tools, mine are worn through.
